Centralize the current64-byte view preflight/factory so immediate/exposed paths share it. Static operation delegates carry no guest/host/root state. acceptance: Freeze native before/after with distinct and repeated receivers, exposed/expanded/custom controls; require affected allocation reduction and exact semantics/fuel/error/spans. Views remain live, original receiver survives rebinding, iterator mutation errors and arity effects match Python. Refuse64-byte view admission before mutation while keeping dict/aliases funded; retained results/caches and actual receiver-expression I/O/cancellation still work.58 complete jobs;no new memory or regex work.
stopping: Only items/keys/values exact PyDict zero-positional-argument form. No setdefault/pop/update/clear/copy, general dictionary/binder inventory, new dispatcher/cache/owner or retiming. Reject if this needs new ownership/iteration infrastructure. Decide value from bounded distinct-row diagnostic, not final-sort workload call counts.
